title: Specification of the gate CNF
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $p$ be a tuple of an input-head position and work-head positions, let $q$ be a case consisting of an optional state, an optional input symbol, and one optional symbol per work tape, and let $b$ be a codec bit. The cost of the CNF formula assigned to these data is at most $2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$, and for every Boolean assignment $a$ to its variables, the formula evaluates to the gate value on the port assignment obtained by reading the wired variables from $a$.
